newsitem.title: USA: High Plains Corp retires $13.2 mln debt.
newsitem.headline: High Plains Corp retires $13.2 mln debt.

text.p: High Plains Corp said Wednesday it has retired the $13.2 million balance of its debt through Bank One, Indianapolis, with proceeds from a new loan from the National Bank of Canada.
High Plains said the new financing package includes an $11 million, five-year-term loan and a $4 million revolving loan secured by the comapny's York, Nebraska, ethanol plant.
"We were able to prepay the Bank One debt without prepayment penalty," said Raymond Friend, the company's chief financial officer.
High Plains also announced the completion of new financing, through MetLife Capital Corp, to fund its Industrial Grade Ethanol production upgrade.
High Plains is one of the nation's largest producers of ethanol.
